assessment.instructions: Assess appeals for a drug, procedure, device or therapy. Determine whether documented treatment response and indication evidence resolve the request. Failed alternatives alone do not justify investigational care; patient preference alone is not necessity. Exclude level-of-care disputes. Use supplied patient facts only. The insurer denial is the starting allegation, not the independent review outcome. Missing information is unknown, not a negative finding. Do not invent policy terms or clinical facts.

criteria.Upheld: Explicit findings show the requested intervention is ineffective, inappropriate for this indication, or unnecessary given an effective suitable alternative.
criteria.Overturned: Persistent disease plus documented failure, intolerance or contraindication of relevant alternatives supports this specifically indicated intervention, or explicit indication evidence directly rebuts denial.
criteria.Unresolved: Insufficient indication or treatment history, conflicting evidence, investigational uncertainty, or an out-of-scope level-of-care appeal.
